audit_items.proof_trace: ELMemPoolRequirements is an empty requirement list (line 77 in verification/blob.go), bypassing all KZG proof verification including RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified. Line 706's comment "We trust the execution layer" directly contradicts the property's semi-trusted requirement. Blobs from EL are upgraded to VerifiedRODataColumn without any cryptographic verification.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A compromised or malicious execution layer can provide blobs with invalid KZG commitments/proofs. These blobs bypass verification (lines 706-714) and propagate through the network as verified data columns, violating the consensus layer's trust assumptions and enabling invalid state propagation.
